name: mini-bot-zero-sleep
description: Ultra-lightweight 24/7 Zero-Sleep WhatsApp MD Bot for Heroku with 120+ Commands, Pairing Code & Keepalive

APP_URL.description: Public URL of this Heroku app (e.g. https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com) for 24/7 self-ping keepalive

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string for persistent session backup across dyno restarts (optional)

NEWSLETTER_JID.description: WhatsApp Channel JID for the View Channel forward badge (e.g. 120363431913895899@newsletter)

CHANNEL_NAME.description: Channel title displayed on View Channel forward badge
